Senior Backend Engineer

About us
Northwind Payments builds payment infrastructure for small online businesses. We process billions of dollars a year with a small, senior team.

What you'll do
- Design, build and operate high-throughput payment services in Go and Python
- Own the reliability of services you ship, including on-call rotations
- Design REST APIs used by thousands of merchants
- Improve our CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling
- Mentor engineers and review code across teams

What you'll need
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong experience with Go or Python
- PostgreSQL and Redis in production
- AWS, Docker and Kubernetes
- Experience designing and operating microservices
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have
- Kafka or another event streaming platform
- Terraform
- GraphQL

Benefits
- Remote-first, with quarterly team offsites
- Health, dental and vision insurance

Northwind Payments is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants without regard to race, religion or gender.
